en: The postcard shows a black-and-white illustration framing a rural agricultural settlement. The drawing features a woman holding a sheaf of grain on the left and a muscular man with a wide-brimmed hat and a scythe on the right, each pointing towards the center. Behind them, there is a photo of people, fields, and buildings resembling a moshav or kibbutz. Hebrew and English text is present.
